meta.description: Assigns honest lipid annotation levels, class-based internal-standard quantification, and lipid-aware differential/enrichment analysis while guarding against annotation and quantification over-claims.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: No fresh output fabricated literature, clinical results, or statistics.

practice_boundaries.detail: The patient-diagnosis input was refused under the explicit Practice Boundaries section.

methodological_ground.detail: Outputs preserve evidence-dependent annotation, class-matched standards, and targeted confirmation requirements.

code_usability.detail: Fresh R/lipidr and Python/pygoslin executions completed the exact source scripts and example.

functional_suitability.note: Covers annotation, quantification, differential analysis, enrichment, artifacts, and clinical boundaries.

reliability.note: Current scripts loudly handle Class=NA and missing standards; malformed Goslin strings still expose parser errors.

performance_context.note: Uses focused scripts, but enrichment plotting is slow and noisy on Windows.

agent_usability.note: Decision tables, version checks, commands, and common-error remedies are clear.

human_usability.note: Natural triggers and analytical limits are plainly stated.

security.note: No secrets or destructive operations; lipid-name parser errors are not wrapped.

maintainability.note: Focused R/Python scripts and one end-to-end example separate responsibilities.

agent_specific.note: Precise triggers, routing, stop conditions, and practice boundaries are strong.

key_strengths: The exact ISTD script guards missing class standards and unparsed Class=NA rows on real lipidr data.
The supplied workflow completed live and produced a differential table plus two substantive graphics.
Goslin downgrade behavior retains corrected ether/plasmalogen output while preventing sn-position over-claims.
The explicit research-only boundary safely refuses patient diagnosis.

recommendations.title: Wrap malformed Goslin input errors
recommendations.problem: honest_level.py exposes raw pygoslin parser exceptions for malformed lipid names.
recommendations.root_cause: There is no try/except layer around parser.parse().
recommendations.fix: Catch parser exceptions, name the offending input, and return a concise correction hint without changing valid-name behavior.

recommendations.title: Document example runtime and persistent output option
recommendations.problem: The full enrichment example completes but writes to tempdir and is slow/noisy on Windows.
recommendations.root_cause: Output location and runtime expectation are implicit.
recommendations.fix: Accept an optional output directory and state that enrichment plotting can be slow on constrained Windows hosts.
